title: Qwen3.5-4B BF16 on vLLM: single 24GB card, and the 4090 same-vocab draft
slug_note: 9.3GB BF16 with a vision encoder on one 24GB card; also the same-vocab speculative draft in the outsourc-e RTX 4090 recipes.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-25 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve at 32K; the draft-model role runs under mainline llama.cpp in the outsourc-e recipes instead

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 113.9 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 9.3GB weights + KV; the 256K native context is out of reach on a 24GB card.

steps.text: For the draft role: load the Q4_K_M GGUF alongside Qwen3.6-27B in mainline llama.cpp per the recipe repo

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (635-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

caveats: Doubles as the same-vocab (248,320-token BPE) speculative draft for Qwen3.6-27B in the outsourc-e RTX 4090 recipes; cross-vocab drafts silently corrupted JSON and tool calls there.
Size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 250 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 113.9 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
